hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.md|*.mdx|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.yml|*.yaml) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *) [ -f "$f" ] && sed -i '' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; true
